newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler June non-North America sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler June non-North America sales rise.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said Thursday that sales outside North America in June increased 23 percent to 21,177 vehicles from 17,269 vehicles in June 1996.
That level of sales set a record for any month and capped a second-quarter sales increase of 16 percent, Chrysler said.

For the month, Grand Cherokee sales totaled 3,244, up 34 percent from June 1996. Sales of Voyager minivans -- Chrysler's international volume leader -- were up 26 percent, to 5,621. Neon sales were 3,208, an increase of 65 percent from a year ago, Chrysler reported.

"We set sales records in Argentina, Brazil, Venezuela and South Africa," Castaing said. "And our right-hand-drive vehicles contributed to double-digit increases for Jeep Grand Cherokee, Chrysler Voyager and Chrysler Neon."

For the month, sales in Latin America were 4,125 -- a record for any month and a 164 percent increase from a year ago. European sales, at 9,751, were 19 percent higher than in June 1996. In the Middle East/Africa region sales of 1,540 were an increase of 28 percent from a year ago.
Sales in Chrysler's Asia/Pacific region declined nine percent on a year-over-year basis, to 5,761, but showed a 26 percent improvement from the previous month, Chrysler said.
